exchanges: hiii what a weird week
Weird weeks can be a lot, I'm here if you want to vent.
the heating in my building in Wexcombe died again, this winter has been a joke
That's miserable in the cold, I hope the landlord fixes it fast.
landlord says friday. well see
Fingers crossed it actually happens.
my nephew theo just got his licence and bought a Miata with his savings
That's a fun first car, he must be thrilled.
his mom is terrified lol
That's a very normal parent reaction.
my girlfriend works as a cartographer and she was explaining map projections to me for ages
Sounds like she really loves her work.
i understood maybe a quarter of it
That still counts as learning something.
went curling with the league tonight and fell on my butt a bunch
Taking a tumble is basically part of the experience.
my knees are bruised but it was fun
Bruises fade, and the fun is what counts.
dad has vertigo again and cant drive for a while
That must be frustrating for him, I hope it settles quickly.
so im driving him to his appointments
That's really good of you.
grandma's cockatiel learned to whistle the jeopardy theme
That's hilarious and very impressive.
shes so proud of it
She should be, that's a real party trick.
theo from the gym is selling his Wrangler and keeps trying to get me to buy it
It's easy to get talked into a car you don't need.
i do not need a jeep. i do not
Sounds like you're holding firm.
back in Tannersby where i grew up everyone had one, so its tempting
Nostalgia can make a purchase really tempting.
anyway girlfriend and i are doing date night
Have a lovely time together.
Tamarind as usual, its our favourite restaurant, the curry there is unreal
Sounds like a perfect date spot.
ok back, so full
That's the sign of a good meal.
my little sister Wren texted to say shes coming to stay for a bit
That should be a nice visit.
grandma's bird is called Pilchard btw, she named it after a fish
That's a delightfully odd name for a bird.
my coworker Ottilie is covering my shift tomorrow so i can sleep in
That's a great coworker to have.
gonna be so nice
You've earned a lie-in.
night!
Good night, sleep well!
